containers.name: stage
command:
import shutil,time,json
from pathlib import Path
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
src=Path('/checkpoints/gms-restore-0928/glm-capture-1');dst=Path('/gms-artifacts/glm-capture-1')
started=time.time()
def move_rank(rank):
    target=dst/f'device-{rank}'
    if target.exists():shutil.rmtree(target)
    source=src/f'device-{rank}'
    target.mkdir(parents=True)
    for f in source.rglob('*'):
        rel=f.relative_to(source);out=target/rel
        if f.is_dir():out.mkdir(exist_ok=True);continue
        shutil.copyfile(f,out)
        assert out.stat().st_size==f.stat().st_size
    print(json.dumps({'rank':rank,'copied_s':time.time()-started}),flush=True)
    shutil.rmtree(source)
with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=8) as pool:list(pool.map(move_rank,range(8)))
print('MOVED',time.time()-started,flush=True)
while True:time.sleep(60)
